newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Prazdroj 1996 net profit drops.
newsitem.headline: Czech Prazdroj 1996 net profit drops.

text.p: Czech brewer Plzensky Prazdroj a.s. said on Thursday its 1996 after-tax profit fell to 95 million crowns from 158 million crowns in the previous year.

Company officials told journalists in a presentation at the Prague Stock Exchange that total turnover rose in 1996 to 4.6 billion crowns from 3.6 billion crowns, according to preliminary results which are subject to an audit.
Operating profit rose to 953.5 million crowns from 531.8 million crowns.
The brewer, based in the western Czech city of Plzen, is maker of the flagship Czech lager Pilsner Urquell, and the poplular domestic label Gambrinus.
